sentiment.rationale: Full-year comparable sales guidance was lowered to 'roughly flat' from the prior range of 'flat to up +1%', and adjusted operating margin guidance was reduced to 12.1% from 12.2% to 12.3%. Management explicitly cites 'ongoing macroeconomic uncertainty' and a 'cautious consumer' with the 'timing of an inflection in the home improvement and housing markets remains unclear.' This constitutes a clear downward revision to forward expectations, warranting a score of -0.5.

summary.revenue: Third quarter sales were $20.8 billion, with comparable sales increasing 0.4% year-over-year.
summary.eps: Adjusted diluted EPS of $3.06, an increase of 6% versus the prior-year quarter.
summary.guidance: Full-year comparable sales expected to be roughly flat (previously flat to up +1%); total sales of approximately $86 billion; adjusted operating margin of approximately 12.1% (previously 12.2% to 12.3%); adjusted diluted EPS of approximately $12.25 (previously $12.20 to $12.45).
summary.margin: Adjusted operating margin of 12.4% in Q3, up 10 basis points versus prior year. Full-year adjusted operating margin guidance reduced to approximately 12.1%.
key_risks: Ongoing macroeconomic uncertainty and a cautious consumer.
Elevated borrowing costs for longer than anticipated, weighing on larger discretionary purchases.
Hurricane-related headwinds (roughly 100 basis points in Q3, also cycling in Q4).
Tariff pressures expected to continue ramping in Q4 and affect the first half of 2026.
Timing of an inflection in the home improvement and housing markets remains unclear.
key_opportunities: Continued execution of Total Home Strategy, including growth in Pro, Online, and Home Services.
Acquisition of Foundation Building Materials (FBM) enhancing Pro offering and providing countercyclical commercial exposure.
AI initiatives (Mylow, Mylow Companion) driving conversion and customer satisfaction.
Potential for home equity financing (HELOCs) to spur demand as rates decline.
Strong homeowner balance sheets and record home equity levels.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management repeatedly uses phrases like 'uncertain macro environment,' 'cautious consumer,' and 'the timing of an inflection...remains unclear,' while also expressing confidence in long-term strategy.
